description: This file implements conversion logic for Custom Resources in Kubernetes, including a factory for creating converters, handling different conversion strategies, and supporting scale and field selection features.

classes.name: CRConverterFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating converters for Custom Resources, supporting different conversion strategies and webhook integration.

classes.name: crConverter
classes.description: Handles conversion of individual Custom Resources, including scale support and version validation.

classes.name: safeConverterWrapper
classes.description: Wraps an unsafe converter to provide safe, deep-copied conversions.

methods.name: NewCRConverterFactory
methods.description: Creates a new CRConverterFactory with webhook support.

methods.name: NewConverter
methods.description: Creates a new converter based on CRD specifications, including scale and field selector support.

methods.name: ConvertFieldLabel
methods.description: Converts field labels, supporting metadata.name, namespace, and selectable fields.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Performs conversion between runtime objects, handling scale and unstructured types.

methods.name: ConvertToVersion
methods.description: Converts an object to a specified version, with deep copy for safety.
